records.text: Erika Kirk, the McCoys, Elizabeth, and Mikey were in joyous spirits at a private dinner on September 22, 2025.

appearances.snippet: On the 21st is the public memorial event that is held at State Farm Stadium. And on the 22nd, which I had not mentioned before—I've been building this timeline in the background—there's a private dinner. ... but the McCoys are there, ... Elizabeth (one of the McCoys; full identity unverified), ... Mikey (Michael McCoy), ... Erika (Erika Kirk), ... and they're in joyous spirits is exactly what the email said of someone who was there. They were in joyous spirits.

verification.notes: This is attributed to unnamed private sources describing a private dinner. Searches of current reporting did not produce independently attributable evidence of the dinner, its attendees, or Erika Kirks demeanor, so the claim cannot be verified from public evidence.
